evidence.observation: O2 climbs monotonically from ~6 ppm to 51.5 ppm through growth, versus ~5 ppm baseline
Tube pressure drifts up 2.98 -> 3.44 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure/O2 rise is not flow-driven
Temperature control stable at 750 °C, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: A flow-off pressure-rise (rate-of-rise) leak check, or pumping-line/valve position data to rule out exhaust restriction; O2 response to increased Ar purge.
